title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Final Detention Invoice Line
content:
## What this covers

When every clock of a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record has come to a stop, the record's final invoice includes a detention line. That line states the detention days billed in excess of free time, the first and the last detention day it bills, and the detention amount. A record all of whose detention days fell within free time receives no detention line.

## Booking the line: `book_detention_invoice_dba94f21`

This is an agent-side tool that is not in the standing tool list. The agent unlocks it first and then calls it directly; the customer takes no part in running it.

**What it does.** It writes the detention line of the record's final invoice as a new invoice entry dated on the day of booking, carrying the days billed, the first and last day covered and the amount. The amount is added to what the billed party owes on the record, and the record then shows as invoiced. The entry is recorded as import detention on an import record and as export detention on an export record. Once booked, the customer can see the detention line and the raised balance.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dnd_id` | reference number of the free-time record being invoiced, as the free-time record lookup shows it | text identifier |
| `chargeable_days` | detention days billed in excess of free time | whole number of calendar days |
| `period_start_date` | first detention day the line covers | date written YYYY-MM-DD |
| `period_end_date` | last detention day the line covers | date written YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount_usd` | detention amount of the line | positive US dollar figure to 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent when passed |

**Return.** A successful booking returns one sentence of the form "Detention invoice line <invoice reference> booked on record <dnd_id>: <days> day(s) from <start> to <end>, USD <amount>; balance due now USD <balance>." The invoice reference is the identifier customers quote for the line, and the balance is the record's outstanding amount in US dollars to 2 decimals after the line is added. A reply beginning "Error:" means that no record exists under the reference given and nothing has been booked.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does the line carry the date on which the record's charges stopped?**
The entry itself is dated on the day it is booked; the days it bills are stated separately as its first and last detention day.

**Q: Is a detention line raised for a record whose detention never went past its free time?**
No; such a record receives no detention line.
